COR 1
toastMsg: Successfully Linked Reg Feed Document with Decisions Entity
failedMsg: Failed to create mapping for Document
getDocumentData: SELECT d.document_key, d.ref_id, d.category, d.pdf_url, d.official_id, d.title, d.jurisdiction, d.summary_text, DATE_FORMAT(d.publication_date, '%m-%d-%Y') AS publicationDate, DATE_FORMAT(d.updated_at, '%m-%d-%Y') AS updatedDate, d.dismiss, d.take_action, d.subj_area, d.customer_key, d.provenance, d.clean_citations, d.regulator_code, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT fda.name) AS agency, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT cfr.cite) AS cfr, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT dock.docket_id) AS docket, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT top.name) AS topic, (CASE WHEN fdd.status IS NULL THEN 'New' ELSE fdd.status END) AS STATUS, fdd.assignee AS assignee FROM feed_document d LEFT JOIN feed_agency fda ON fda.document_key = d.document_key LEFT JOIN feed_cfr_part cfr ON cfr.document_key = d.document_key LEFT JOIN feed_docket dock ON dock.document_key = d.document_key LEFT JOIN feed_topic top ON top.document_key = d.document_key LEFT JOIN feed_document_decisions fdd ON fdd.document_key = d.document_key WHERE d.customer_key = 'REG' AND d.source_id = 1 AND (fdd.status IN ('new') OR fdd.status IS NULL) AND TRIM(LOWER(d.title)) = TRIM(LOWER(?)) ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC, d.publication_date DESC
